label: Mutual TLS (mTLS)
type: a TLS configuration in which both peers present and validate certificates, so the server authenticates the client as well as the reverse. Requires cert:client-certificate and cert:node-certificate together.
note: Promoted as the configuration that ties the certificate family to the wire. Distinct from tls:node-to-node-encryption, which is about which hops are encrypted rather than who proves identity to whom - two settings that are easy to conflate and are configured separately.
